svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One blank, cut and folded: a base 470 x 98 mm with two guide tabs

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 120 x 50 mm on each long edge at the bottom bracket end, and one

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: latch ear tab 62 x 31 mm on the left edge at the head tube end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold the three tabs up 90 degrees on the base's edges, inside radius

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: about 4.5 mm (1.5 x thickness). Inside faces 92 mm apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Band slots: three pairs, 3 x 13 mm, 19 to 22 mm each side of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre line, at 100 mm below, at, and 100 mm above the middle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Air windows 68 x 44 mm either side of the middle slots.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every other hole is on the layout picture: drill, countersink where

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it says, deburr. Base, guides and ear have no welds.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: sits on the three V-saddles; the band clamps pass through

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the slots and over the base between them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the SwapCell envelope gauge drops between the guides with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1 mm each side; the base lies flat within 1 mm over its length.
